p02-diego-jacket-off.observed_description: On a hot, dry, sunlit day Diego (grey T-shirt, jeans) stands sweating with his right arm out of a heavy brown jacket, which he pulls down off his left arm.
p02-diego-jacket-off.note: Usable: heat and the jacket coming off read at 250 px. Diego stands at the left edge, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards (four_card false).

p04-luis-boots-off.observed_description: Luis in a wet navy raincoat sits on a bench inside his open front door while rain falls on the path outside, and pulls at the black rubber boot on his lifted left foot; water drips onto the mat.
p04-luis-boots-off.note: Usable: coming in out of the rain and working the wet boot off read at 250 px; still a pull rather than a boot in hand, so the lesson never sets put on against take off for this photo. Phone-check note.
